newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore blue chips drift, focus on small stocks.
newsitem.headline: Singapore blue chips drift, focus on small stocks.

text.p: Singapore blue chip stocks drifted lower in early trading on Friday and investors kept their focus on low-priced and small sized stocks, dealers said.
They said institutional activity lacked direction as Wall Street was closed on Thursday due to Thanksgiving.
The key Straits Times Industrials Index eased 6.98 points to 2,192.69 at 0216 GMT.
"There are little orders coming in and they are mostly on the sell side," said an institutional dealer.
Retailers were buying electronic shares and recently listed stocks, dealers said.
Electronic company Flextech took the top active spot with 3.3 million shares, which included a block trade of one million shares. It rose Singapore $0.03 (US$0.02) to S$0.975.
"We think Flextech had good earningS potential and are recomending our clients to buy," said one dealer.
Multimedia company Aztech saw some recovery, up S$0.02 to S$0.47 on news its sale and manufacturing of sound cards did not infringe on Creative's sound card copyright.
Another electronic firm Advanced Systems Automation rose S$0.04 to S$1.43 after posting strong half-year results.
